p.title: v59.97 the current-number check reads normalised text and spelled units and currency codes
p.symptom: Eleven current numbers passed the numeric-evidence check and were published unbound, among them 'VIX 지수는 15.2입니다.', '**VIX** 15.2입니다.', '실업률은 4.1 퍼센트입니다.', '실업률은 4.1％입니다.', '삼성전자 주가는 KRW 72,000입니다.', '엔비디아 주가는 １８２.３달러입니다.' and 'The 10-year yield is 4.15 percent.'.
p.root_cause: hasCurrentNumericContent matched raw text: markdown emphasis separated a metric from its number, full-width digits and '％' were not digits or '%', '지수' after VIX, '퍼센트', the codes KRW/USD before or after a number and the English words dollars/percent were not units, and splitAnswerSentences ended a sentence at a period glued to a full-width digit.
p.fix: hasCurrentNumericContent tests a normalised copy (NFKC, emphasis and backticks removed), allows '지수' after VIX and adds SPELLED_UNIT_NUMBER for 퍼센트, KRW/USD/US$ and dollars/percent with word boundaries; splitAnswerSentences treats a period followed by a full-width letter or digit as glued, so kept sentences are published in their original text.
p.violated_rule: A current number that is not bound to evidence is not published (P1519/P1740 numeric-evidence publication policy).
p.prevention: scripts/ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check.mjs v59.97 block: the eleven spellings must be detected and stripped, five unit words or codes without a current number must be kept, and a kept sentence beside a stripped full-width number keeps its original text.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check.mjs (the 11 detection assertions and the full-width split assertion failed on the old source, pass now); ci-ai-chat-reliability-contract-check, ci-pipeline-semantics-check, regex-term and text-pin ratchets, boot bundle budget exit 0.

changelog: **Current-number check reads spelled units and full-width digits ({P}):** an AI sentence with '**VIX** 15.2', 'VIX 지수는 15.2', '4.1 퍼센트', '4.1％', 'KRW 72,000', '182.3 dollars', '4.15 percent' or full-width digits is now treated as a current number and dropped unless bound to evidence; unit words and codes without a number stay.
note: v59.97: numeric-evidence check normalises text and reads spelled units
